judged_text: findMembers returns undefined (bare 'return ;') when the group name is empty, while all call sites (admin route setupController, group-members route, removeMember/addMembers reload) treat it as a promise. Any caller that chains .then on findMembers (the deleted afterModel pattern, or future reload chains in removeMember's '.then(function() { self.findMembers(); })' successors) crashes with a TypeError for a nameless record; the old code returned an RSVP.resolve so the contract silently changed.

adjudication.rationale: In `Discourse.Group.findMembers` the empty-name guard changed from `return Ember.RSVP.resolve([]);` to a bare `return ;` (undefined). That is a contract change visible in the diff. However, in the current diff all shown call sites invoke `findMembers()` without chaining (`setupController` in both routes just calls it; `removeMember`/`addMembers` call `self.findMembers()` inside their own `.then` but don’t chain on its return; admin paging actions return it but don’t `.then` it). So the specific “will crash because callers `.then` it” isn’t verifiable from this diff, but the API inconsistency is real and could break any existing/future `.then` usage.
